title: Prescriptions Schedule of Short-Fill Days on Relabel Remakes
content:
Where the mislabeled fill of a Kestrel Prescriptions record was itself dispensed short, the relabel short-fill allowance applies to its relabel remake.

## Schedule

The relabel short-fill allowance looks at the owed-balance entry booked for the mislabeled fill on the fill ledger:

| Owed units booked for the mislabeled fill | Allowance days |
|---|---|
| at least equal to the units dispensed on it | 2 |
| fewer than the units dispensed, but more than zero | 1 |
| none — the mislabeled fill was dispensed complete | none |

Each allowance day adds the prescribed daily units — the prescription's written quantity divided by its written days supply — to the relabel remake quantity.

## Readings (hypothetical mislabeled fill of 20 units dispensed, 2 prescribed daily units)

- 20 owed units booked for it: 2 days, 4 units added.
- 8 owed units booked for it: 1 day, 2 units added.
- No owed-balance entry for it: no days.
